nodes.label: Exact dependency version pinning (Vite 5 vs Vite 8)
nodes.rationale: A caret in package.json previously let a fresh install pull Vite 8 against a codebase developed on Vite 5; Vite 7+ loads vite.config.ts as native ESM where __dirname doesn't exist, breaking the @core/@ui alias resolution and rendering a blank page. Fixed by pinning every version exactly.

nodes.label: vite.config.ts fileURLToPath fix
nodes.rationale: Config switched to fileURLToPath(import.meta.url), which works under every module loader, instead of __dirname which native ESM lacks.

nodes.label: ErrorBoundary component
nodes.rationale: Catches render errors and prints message and stack on screen, so a break shows what broke rather than a white blank page.
